title: C: State Pattern
description: Implement the State design pattern where an object changes behavior based on its internal state.

steps.title: Document State Machine
steps.description: Define states: DRAFT, MODERATION, PUBLISHED. For each state, define function pointers for `edit`, `review`, and `publish` actions that return the next state. Start in DRAFT, edit -> stays DRAFT, review -> MODERATION, publish -> PUBLISHED.
hints: Each state is a set of function pointers in a struct.
Functions take no args and return a State enum value.
Call appropriate function based on current state.
